external_primary_evidence: Kim et al., Reward Identification in Inverse Reinforcement Learning, PMLR 2021
Metelli et al., Towards Theoretical Understanding of Inverse Reinforcement Learning, PMLR 2023
Shehab et al., Learning true objectives: Linear algebraic characterizations of identifiability in inverse reinforcement learning, PMLR 2024
Santos et al., An LP-Based Approach for Goal Recognition as Planning, AAAI 2021
Shvo and McIlraith, Active Goal Recognition, AAAI 2020
observed_architecture: WP804 already separates GOAL from ABSTAIN and permits exact goal labels only when declared public evidence uniquely identifies one candidate.
WP804 collapses all non-identifiable cases to the same ABSTAIN decision in GoalInferenceScore; the score does not retain the public-compatible candidate-goal set.
Hyperposition already provides a typed authority-free set of unresolved Alternative values with provenance and exact generation/digest binding.
Hyperposition DiscriminatorCandidate already targets two or more alternatives and carries expected-information-gain and estimated-cost values without action/effect authority.
Epistemic Action Selection already ranks Hyperposition-bound discriminators against an exact GRID10 plan and emits proposal-only output.
Active Sensing already compiles an explicit VisualNeed into a permission-bound ObserveIntent and grants no capture, truth, effect or completion authority.
WP802 currently evaluates a predeclared COMMIT_FIRST or PROBE_THEN_COMMIT public policy; it does not establish that a specific goal-ambiguity set causally selects the discriminating probe.

proposed_shape.name: F2_PUBLIC_GOAL_AMBIGUITY_HYPERPOSITION_ADAPTER/v0
proposed_shape.flow: WP804 public ObservationView + CandidateGoal set -> derive public-compatible candidate goal ids -> if cardinality > 1 map each compatible goal to existing Hyperposition Alternative -> existing DiscriminatorCandidate -> existing Epistemic Action Selection -> optional existing Active Sensing path
required_invariants: Only the same declared public inputs available to WP804 policy code may enter the adapter.
Evaluator-only goal labels or hidden fixture state must never enter the Hyperposition projection.
Compatible-goal membership is candidate structure, not inferred world truth or adopted goal authority.
No new canonical state store, goal authority, effect path or completion authority is introduced.
Existing Hyperposition generation/digest/provenance fences remain mandatory.
The adapter must be pure/deterministic and its output reconstructible from exact public input digests.
A binary ABSTAIN remains valid when an external interface requires only the decision; the richer set is an optional internal research projection, not a replacement truth label.

expected_benefit.capability: Preserve which goals remain plausible after an abstention so the existing discriminator/action-selection machinery can choose evidence targeted at the actual ambiguity.
expected_benefit.token_cost: Expected near-zero model-token cost because the proposed bridge is deterministic typed state rather than additional LLM arbitration.
expected_benefit.runtime_cost: Expected O(number_of_candidate_goals) deterministic set construction plus existing Hyperposition objects; unmeasured until E4.
expected_benefit.architecture_reuse: High: reuses WP804, Hyperposition, Epistemic Action Selection and Active Sensing instead of adding a second hypothesis system.

counterhypothesis.statement: The richer ambiguity set provides no measurable benefit beyond binary ABSTAIN because downstream information-seeking can derive all useful probes directly from ObservationView or because existing Hyperposition inputs already encode equivalent ambiguity elsewhere.
counterhypothesis.falsifier: Construct matched held-out microworld pairs with identical initial ABSTAIN outcome but different public-compatible goal sets and different uniquely useful probe actions. Compare a binary-ABSTAIN baseline against the thin Hyperposition adapter under the same public evidence and action budget. If the adapter does not improve correct probe selection / downstream commit accuracy or merely reproduces already-existing derived state, retire the delta.
